LOne other thing though, the triceratops is a vegetarian,, why are we feeding it meat? 😂. Despite the bugs I'm going to keep the game as it looks like it will be more fun. Dino Quest VR offers a nice mix of exploration, puzzles and dinosaur encounters. Hunting fossils and discovering ancient ruins creates a real adventure feeling. The world is fun to explore and the recent combat additions make survival even more exciting. Looking forward to discovering more.

reviews.review_title: Dino Quest VR: A Jurassic Adventure! 🦖
reviews.review_description:
Dino Quest VR starts off as a deceptively simple puzzle game—break rocks, collect items, and solve easy puzzles to escape. But don’t let the initial ease fool you; this game quickly ramps up the challenge with a delightful mix of mechanics that keep things fresh and engaging.
From retrieving explosives to luring a triceratops with a piece of meat, sneaking past oviraptors by collecting ammo, and navigating a light labyrinth that tests your patience, Dino Quest VR packs in a surprising amount of variety. The moving puzzles add another layer of complexity, ensuring that no two levels feel the same.
What could have been a straightforward game instead becomes a solid adventure filled with creativity and diversity. It’s a testament to how a simple premise can evolve into something much more engaging. If you’re looking for a fun, varied VR experience that keeps you on your toes, Dino Quest VR is worth diving into. Just be prepared to face some prehistoric challenges along the way! 🦕💥

I had an enjoyable time playing Dino Quest VR. It combines two of my favorite things: puzzles and dinosaurs. Solving puzzles while being chased by hungry, scary creatures makes everything more exciting.

I'm looking forward to seeing how the game grows with future updates!

reviews.review_title: A basic but fun Dino fossil puzzle game
reviews.review_description: If anyone else get stuck the first time where nothing is grabbing, I restarted the game and it worked as should have. Initially, items were not tracking and didn’t feel the “feedback” that signals item is ready to be picked up/grab. The sound the T-Rex makes is very disappointing. It doesn’t have the classic T-Rex roar or any roar at that matter, it just creeps up on you in silence but has this occasional low rumble growl. Also, the timing of the security gates dropping is not the same. Before the T. Rex showed up, the gate would drop almost instantly. However, while being chased by the trex, I can hear it but the gate wouldn’t drop till moments later or too late as the tree would had closed the gap by then. Was working just fine the first play through but oddly different experience second attempt. Furthermore, would be more immersive if breaking the rocks containing the fossils have more durability. Would feel more immersive if it took idk, 6 hits, instead of a couple with the pick axe to break. Feels too easy and not very engaging. Just finished the first round and even with all this, I’m willing to continue just cuz I’m a Dino nerd and always down for a Dino vr exp. So what this game is about, you’re basically breaking these rocks contains bones to construct a skeleton each round. While you’re doing this, you’ll have encounters and have to find ways to trap the T. rex with different gate switches. There’s literally no settings or options, just straight into the game. for the price, I don’t feel like I’m getting my moneys worth so far. I’d have to recommend this game only when on a discount.

Cave exploration, simple puzzles, and fossil mining and assembling are a superb mix. Sometimes the physical engine is incomplete, but it's not too inconvenient.
If it has the effect of automatically closing the entrance when you find all the fossils and enter the room, it will be relieved when chased by dinosaurs.
I think it will have an educational effect if the dinosaur data are shown briefly after completed fossil integration.

I like the concept. Dig up those bones. Lock 🦕 in, blow up entrances. Use you 🧠  to get all the bones. Found your way out  to put the bones, that you have found , togheter into a puzzle. 

I had some glitches. But I am sure these are gonna be resolved soon.
I just played it for the first time today, and I really enjoyed it. Great experience so far.
